origin: cwe/352/python Taint Sinks: @csrf_exempt on state-changing Django views

finding.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
finding.summary: A cookie-authenticated POST view that changes a user's billing email is explicitly exempted from Django CSRF validation.

trap: Adding SameSite cookie settings, checking request.method, or requiring only request.user.is_authenticated while leaving @csrf_exempt in place. The state-changing POST still accepts a forged browser request without a CSRF token.
must_preserve: POST requests from authenticated users with a valid CSRF token still return JSON status "queued" and call BillingMailer.queue_change(). Missing sessions still return the existing 401 JSON shape, and non-POST methods still return 405 JSON.
